name: Helmed Horror

source.note: The 2025 Monster Manual has a newer block that isn't in SRD 5.2.1; this one keeps the 2014 numbers until it can be checked against the book. Numbers follow the 2014 Monster Manual helmed horror. Entered from knowledge, not yet checked against the book. Blind beyond its blindsight. Its resistance to nonmagical, non-adamantine weapons is entered as plain Bludgeoning, Piercing and Slashing resistance. Spell Immunity is text only (the engine has no per-spell immunity); the longsword is used one-handed (it carries a shield).

languages: understands its creator's languages but can't speak

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.summary: Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Spell Immunity
traits.summary: Immune to three spells its maker chose; usually Fireball, Heat Metal and Lightning Bolt.
traits.text: The horror is immune to three spells picked by whoever made it. Fireball, Heat Metal and Lightning Bolt are the usual choices.

summary: An empty, flying suit of plate that fights with a longsword and shrugs off most magic.
